typography.note: Base font size bumped to 17px. The Tailwind fontSize scale (tailwind.config.js) is enlarged ~1 step so all text-* utilities are larger project-wide. Prefer the reusable classes below (defined in src/index.css @layer components) over ad-hoc utility stacks.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Tetris grid with wide gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical layout for 'Industries' and 'Water Solutions' sections. Mobile-first grid-cols-1.
spacing_and_layout.corners: rounded-2xl for main cards, completely sharp (rounded-none) for editorial images to maintain luxury tension.

surfaces_and_materials.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-sm (Use for Navbar and Water Solution Cards)
surfaces_and_materials.cards: Flat background (bg-[#F9FAFB]), 1px solid border-[#E5E7EB], hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 ease-out
surfaces_and_materials.buttons: bg-[#0B0B0B] text-white hover:bg-[#3BA7FF] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-medium

motion_and_interactions.hero: Parallax scroll on background image, slow fade-in stagger for typography.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Cards lift (-translate-y-2), thin icons turn from Black to Crystal Blue on hover.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling. Reveal animations for Testimonials and Process timeline.

components.name: Navigation
components.instructions: Sticky, glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70). Must include full-screen mobile menu overlay for premium feel.

components.name: Hero
components.instructions: Huge Geist typography, editorial spacing. Soft parallax background image of abstract water texture.

components.name: About
components.instructions: Clean Editorial 'About' story layout. Focus on huge typography and asymmetrical image placement.

components.name: Water Solutions Cards
components.instructions: Use 'Glassmorphism' surface rules. Include thin geometric icons. Lift on hover.

components.name: Technology Flow
components.instructions: Interactive multi-stage horizontal timeline representing the filtration process (animated stages).

components.name: Industries Grid
components.instructions: Premium asymmetrical bento grid displaying Villas, Apartments, Commercial.

components.name: Featured Products
components.instructions: Showcase specific products using high-end imagery and minimal typography.

components.name: Process Timeline
components.instructions: Animated step-by-step timeline (Analysis, Consultation, Custom Design, Installation, Support).

components.name: Testimonials
components.instructions: Large elegant quotes with smooth transitions. Use editorial serif or fine sans-serif (Geist).

components.name: Contact Form
components.instructions: Minimalist input fields, bottom border only (no full box), large padding. Submit button with hover effect. Save to FastAPI backend.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure Crystal Blue (#3BA7FF) against White background meets 3:1 for large text, or use it primarily for accents/icons. Rich Black text on White is preferred for readability.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, menu toggles) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle').

hero_background.description: Abstract fluid blue water texture for hero background.

luxury_villa_industry.description: Modern luxury villa exterior for the Industries section.

abstract_water.description: Blue ocean wave for secondary background or featured elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the mobile-first approach. Ensure spacing is extremely generous (p-12 to p-24). Use Geist font for all headings. The layout must feel like a high-end luxury editorial, not a standard SaaS template. Apply data-testid to every interactive component. The app type is hybrid_fullstack, ensure backend API integrates with Contact Form.
